test_HfFileSystem_info: test the HfFileSystem.info method to retrieve metadata about files and directories in a Hugging Face repository
test_HfFileSystem_glob: test the HfFileSystem.glob method to search for files matching patterns across repository paths and revisions
test_HfFileSystem_open: test the HfFileSystem.open method to read and write files in Hugging Face repositories with text and binary modes
test_HfFileSystem_resolve_path: test the HfFileSystem.resolve_path method to parse repository paths with revisions, protocol prefixes, and namespace support
test_HfFileSystem_cache: test the HfFileSystem instance cache and directory cache behavior across multiprocessing contexts
